title: Model Management
no_models_filtered: No models match the current filters
no_associations: This model has no associated providers
no_associations_filtered: No associations match the current filters
load_failed_models: Failed to load models and providers

order.hint: Drag, or press Alt+↑ / Alt+↓ to reorder models
order.at_edge: Already at the start or end of the list
order.blocked_by_filter: Cannot reorder while filters are active — clear them first

association_table.delete_desc: This cannot be undone. The association will be permanently deleted.

bulk.test_desc: This will send {{count}} real requests upstream (billed at each provider's rates). Runs with concurrency 3; progress is shown in the toolbar.
bulk.delete_desc: The following {{count}} associations will be deleted (they can be re-created in batch; logs are unaffected):
bulk.delete_delay_hint: Large selection: the confirm button is delayed by 2 seconds to prevent accidents.
bulk.backfill_desc: Capabilities and prices from the data source will fill empty slots. Note: prices currently 0 will be overwritten by the source price; non-zero prices and set capabilities are untouched. Every filled field is listed afterwards.

model_form.name: Name
model_form.prefer_direct_desc: Pick providers that speak the client's protocol first, and fall back to convertible ones (e.g. an OpenAI client with an Anthropic upstream) only when there are none. Turn it off to let both protocols compete by weight.
model_form.strategy_lottery_desc: Randomly selects based on weight. Best for spreading traffic randomly.
model_form.strategy_rotor_desc: Rotates sequentially by weight. Best for cache-hit scenarios.

association_form.provider_model_placeholder: Type or select a provider model
association_form.provider_model_hint: You can type directly or select from the dropdown
association_form.select_provider_first: Select a provider to load the model list
association_form.header_priority: Priority: Provider Config > Custom Headers > Passthrough Headers
association_form.extra_body_hint: Injects key-value pairs from this JSON into the request body sent to the provider, overriding any matching user-supplied parameters

autofill.title: Auto-fill
autofill.refill_hint: Query the data sources again for the selected provider and model
autofill.idle: Once a provider and provider model are selected, capabilities and prices are filled from public model databases.
autofill.disabled: Auto-fill is turned off in System settings.
autofill.nothing_filled: The data source matches the current form; nothing needed changing.
autofill.missing: Not provided by the data source ({{count}}): {{fields}}
autofill.skipped: Left unchanged because they already have values ({{count}}): {{fields}}
autofill.skipped_hint: Turn on “Overwrite existing values” in System settings and refill to replace them.
autofill.note: Auto-fill uses public model databases and may lag behind the upstream's actual capabilities. Default behaviour can be changed in System settings → Model capability and price auto-fill.

reason.no_provider_match: This provider is not in the data sources, so nothing can be filled.
reason.no_model_match: This model is not in the data sources, so nothing can be filled.
reason.catalog_unavailable: The data sources are not ready yet; retrying automatically. You can also press “Refill”.
reason.deprecated_model: The data source marks this model as deprecated, so nothing is filled.
reason.unknown: No usable model data was returned.

candidates.title: Not found under “{{provider}}”. The data source has a model with the same name under the following providers; adopting it fills in their capabilities and prices:

association_form.backup_hint: Excluded from daily load balancing; only takes over after every primary association fails. Make sure Max Retry leaves enough attempts for the backup pool.

test_dialog.title: Model Test
test_dialog.desc: Select the type of test to run
test_dialog.connectivity_desc: Test the basic connectivity of the model provider
test_dialog.react_desc: Test the model's tool-calling and reasoning capabilities

delete_model_dialog.title: Delete this model?
delete_model_dialog.description: This action cannot be undone. Model {{name}} will be permanently deleted.

delete_association_dialog.title: Delete this association?
delete_association_dialog.description: This action cannot be undone. The association will be permanently deleted.

toast.bulk_disable_title: {{count}} models will have no enabled associations after disabling
toast.bulk_disable_desc: Every enabled association of these models is selected. They still appear in the client /v1/models list after disabling, and calls will fail:

batch_association.title: Batch Associate
batch_association.desc: Attach a batch of upstream models to logical models at once. Same-name is the common case; switch to custom for arbitrary combinations.
batch_association.mode_same-name_desc: Pick upstream models; they attach to same-name logical models
batch_association.mode_assign_desc: Logical models × upstream models, full combination (advanced)
batch_association.paste_placeholder: One upstream model name per line; paste directly
batch_association.no_models_fetched: Model list unavailable or empty for this provider; add names manually
batch_association.no_same_name: No same-name logical model; will be skipped
batch_association.currency_auto: Auto (follows the data source when prices are filled)
batch_association.defaults_hint: Fields left empty are auto-filled from metadata (unfillable ones fall back to defaults and are reported); anything you enter is used as-is, including 0.
batch_association.quota_hint: Multiple associations on the same provider share its quota and failure domain: attaching N rows multiplies the blast radius by N, not the capacity.
batch_association.all_backup_warning: Every association in this batch is backup: if a target model has no primary associations, all traffic goes to the backup pool.
batch_association.price_invalid: Price input cannot be parsed. Fix it and retry (leave blank to autofill).
batch_association.preview_counts: {{create}} to create, {{skip}} existing will be skipped
batch_association.non_same_name_note: This includes non-same-name combinations (logical name ≠ upstream name); make sure that is intended.
batch_association.unfilled_header: Metadata could not be filled for:

reasons.no_provider_match: provider not in the data source
reasons.no_model_match: model not in the data source
reasons.catalog_unavailable: data source not ready (can be filled later)

import_wizard.title: Import from Provider
import_wizard.desc: Pick a provider and bring in its models in bulk: missing logical models are created with the same name; existing ones get the association attached.
import_wizard.diff_create: Will create logical models with associations: {{count}}
import_wizard.diff_attach: Will attach to existing same-name models: {{count}}
import_wizard.models_visible_warning: The {{count}} new logical models will appear immediately in the client-facing /v1/models list.
import_wizard.catalog_warning: Metadata source not ready yet (first fetch in progress): prices will be empty for this import; use "Fill metadata" once it is ready.
import_wizard.attach_policy: When a same-name logical model exists: attach the association (uncheck to skip them)
import_wizard.defaults_hint: These defaults apply only to models created by this import; invalid values are rejected (0 means guaranteed timeout / zero retries).
import_wizard.breaker_advice_title: After attaching, these models will have more primary associations than their retry limit while the breaker is off:
import_wizard.breaker_advice_hint: A primary pool that retries can never exhaust means backup associations will never take over; enabling the breaker lets failed associations leave the pool quickly (toggle in Edit Model).
import_wizard.backfill_hint: (use "Fill metadata" in the list toolbar once ready)
